( mfn. ) doing, making, producing ; Vin V 115, 27* (~ā, in uddāna); Th-a II 176, 21 (pajjotakaro ti pajjotiṃ ~o padīpo, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pajjotakaro, prob. wr ); — ifc see aṭṭa- ( sv aṭṭa 2 ), anta- ( sv anta 1 ), antarāya- ( sv antarāya 1 ), ādi- ( sv ādi 1 ), ānanda-, ārāma-, āloka-, ucchaḍḍana-, evaṃ-, ovāda-, kathaṃ-, kamma-, kāma-, kicca- ( sv karoti ), khamā- ( sv khamā 2 ), divasa-, divā-, vacana-; — 2. ( m. ) ( i ) the act of doing or making ; — ifc see īsa-k- ( sv īsaṃ ), kāma-; — ( ii ) the hand; the trunk of an elephant ; Abh 265; 1047; D III 163, 16* (phusati ~ehi ubhohi jannukāni); Ap 539, 30 ; Mhv 5:255 (rājā … dakkhiṇaṃ ~aṃ … therassādā); — °’- agga , n. [kara + agga 1 ], the tip of an elephant’s trunk ; Abh 365; — °- kaṭaka , m. , a ring-pull or wheel (used for drawing water) ; Vin II 122, 15 (anujānāmi bhikkhave tulaṃ ~aṃ cakkavaṭṭakan ti; Sp 1208, 7 : ~o ti vuccati goṇe yojetvā hatthehi vā gahetvā dīghavarattāhi ākaḍḍhanayantaṃ); — °- ja , m. and mfn. [kara + ja 2 ], 1. ( m. ) a fingernail ; Abh 268; — 2. ( mfn. ) produced by action ;? — ~-kāya, m. , a body produced by action, the physical body ; A V 300, 11 (iminā ~-kāyena pāpakammaṃ kataṃ); Ja I 5, 20 ; Vism 287, 1 ; Sv 113, 19 (manussānaṃ hi kammajatejo mando ~-kāyo balavā); Ps I 249, 4 (~-kāyo nāma cattāri mahābhūtāni upādārūpaṃ cā ti); It-a I 100, 32 (imamhā kāyā aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminātī ti ayaṃ ~-kāyo nāma); — °- tala , m. , t he palm of the hand ; Cp 3:12:2; Ja V 216, 6´ ; — °- pāla , m. ,, °- pālaka , m. ,, a sword ; Sadd 922, 14 ; — °- pālikā , f. , a cudgel ; Abh 392; — °- puṭa , m. , the joined and hollowed hands ; Abh 268 (~o ’njali); — °- bhūsā , f. , a bracelet ; Abh 286; — °- sākhā , f. , a finger ; Abh 266; — atikara , m. , doing too much; an action beyond the usual limit ; Ja I 431, 1* (~am akarācariya; 431, 3´ : ācariya ajja tvaṃ ~aṃ akara attano karaṇato atirekakaraṇaṃ akarī ti attho); — dukkara , mfn. and n. , see sv ; — sukara , mfn. , see sv .
CPD: 2 kara-ja , mfn. [ cf. 6 kara, q.v. ] , born of sowing ( the "seed" in the womb ) ?; used of the physical body; cf. karajarūpa; — exeg.: kirīyati gabbhāsaye khipīyatī ti karo, sambhavo, karato jāto ti ~o, mātāpettika- sambhavo ti attho. mātuyā hi sarīrasaṇṭhāpanava- sena karato jāto ti ~o ti apare. ubhayathā pi kara- jakāyan ti catusantatirūpam āha, Ps-pṭ ll 236, 28 ( in exeg. of kāya at M l 276, 20 ); — w.r. at Sv 113, 22 , 721, 30 for karajakāya, which read with Be.

karajakāya.cp: masc. the body (which is born of impurity.).
karajakāya.p: [Karaja+kāya] (pu) CL=7 The body that happens (or) arises due to semen.

CPD: kara-ja-kāya , m., the physical body, as opposed to its non-physical component viz. nāma or nāmakāyo; only recorded in the pa. canon in A; — exeg.: karo vuccati pupphasambhavaṃ gabbhāsaye karīyatī ti katvā, karato jāto kayo ~o, tadupasannissayo catusantati- rūpasamudāyo, Sv-pṭ l 341, 17 qu. Mp-ṭ lll 12, 2 ≠ Ps-pṭ ll 237, 2 qu. Sadd 239, 23 ; ~o ti ettha tu ko vuc- cati sarīraṃ, tattha pavatto rajo: ka-rajo ... suk- kasoṇitasaṅkhātena karajena sambhūto kayo ~o ti ācariyā, Sadd 239, 9,15 -19; — yaṃ kho me ... pubbe imina ~ena pāpakammaṃ kataṃ, sabban taṃ idha vedanīyaṃ, A V 300, 11 ; 301, 12 ; — ~ defined as mate- rial (vatthu, rūpaṃ): vatthu nāma ~o, yaṃ sandhā- ya vuttaṃ "idañ ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan" (D l 76, 19-20 ) ti, Sv 722, 31 = Ps l 276, 25 = Vibh-a 265, 16 qu. lt-a l 10, 8 ; ~o nāma cattāri mahābhūtāni upādārūpañ cā ti, Sv 764, 26 = Ps l 249, 4 ; imāni jhānaṅgāni kiṃnissitāni ? vatthunis- sitāni. vatthu nāma ~o. jhānaṅgāni nāmaṃ. ~o rūpan ti, Sv 765, 5 = Ps l 249, 14 ; nāmakāyo pi ~o pi passambhati vûpasantadaratho hoti, Mp ll 79, 30 ( ad A l 43, 28 ); 243, 29 ( ad A l 148, 5 ); lll 337, 17 ; bhikkhū- naṃ nāmakāyo santatto nāmakāye santatte ~o san- tatto ~e santatte nidhānagataṃ uṇhaṃ lohitaṃ mu- khato uggañchi, l 68, 11,12 ; — role of ~ in meditation: so ... samāpattito vuṭṭhāya: "samudayo ~o ca cittañ cā" ti passati, Vism 287, 1 qu. Paṭis-a 501, 12 ≠ Sp 431, 4 ; bhikkhuno ~añ ca nāsāpuṭañ ca cittañ ca pa- ṭicca assāsapassāsakāyo aparâparaṃ sañcarati, Sv 765, 21 = Ps l 249, 30 ; attano ~e ... asubhânupassī viharati, Mp lll 140, 6 ( ad A ll 150, 34 ); so ... jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā ... sakalam pi ~aṃ passati, Sp 430, 24 ; ~e ñāṇamattaṃ otāretvā, Dhp-a lll 420, 11 ; ~aṃ ga- hetvā pādakajjhānacitte āropeti, Paṭis-a 662, 29 ( ad Paṭis ll 209, 26 ) ≠ Vism 405, 1 ; taṃ ( scil. lahusañṅā) okkantassa pan' assa ~o pi tūlapicu viya sallahuko hoti, 404, 28 qu. Paṭis-a 662, 19 ; — in similes: maṇi viya ... ~o, Sv 221, 14 = Ps lll 262, 5 ; rahado viya ~o, Sv 218, 27 = Mp lll 234, 8 ; vatthaṃ viya ~o ... evaṃ ca- tutthajjhānasukhena bhikkhuno ~assa na koci okā- so aphuṭṭho hotī ti, Sv 219, 16 = Ps ll 323, 9 = Mp lll 235, 2,6 ; Sv 224, 4 ; ~o ratanavilopakacorasadiso, Ja l 5, 20 ; — ~ may be weak or powerful: manussānaṃ ... kammajatejo mando ~o balavā, Sv 113, 19 (Sv-pṭ l 207, 26 ); devatānaṃ ~aṃ sukhumaṃ ~aṃ balavaṃ, 721, 29 (Sv-pṭ lll 327, 4 ); khīṇâsavānam ... ~assa dub- balabhāvena bhavaṅgotaraṇaṃ hoti, As 378, 18 ; — in glosses on kāya: imaṃ ... kāyan ti imaṃ ~aṃ, Sv 217, 19 ( ad D l 73, 26 ) = Mp lll 232, 15 ( ad A lll 25, 9 ); Ps ll 321, 26 ; Spk ll 396, 1 ; kāyenā ti ~ena, Mp ll 102, 7 ( ad A l 54, 16 ); "imamhā kāyā aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinim- minātī" (D l 77, 9-10 ) ti ayaṃ ~o nāma, lt-a l 100, 32 ; — ifc. catu-mahā-bhūtika- ° (As 403, 21 ).[[side 281]]
